Hi Liam — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps to get the POC running:

- End-to-end latency for retrieval-augmented generation under 600ms median for 512-token prompts

- Stable throughput of ~40 concurrent sessions for 8-hour business-day traffic windows

Evaluation plan & timelines:
- Week 0 (this week): Access & environment provisioned (API keys, IP allowlist, SSO invites) — owner: Redwood eng (Dev Patel)
- Week 1: Ingest sample dataset + run evaluation harness (Zenith + Redwood)
- Week 2: Tuning and checks, interim quality report
- Week 3: Final evaluation and rollout recommendation

Ownership & action items:
- Redwood: Provide API key, SSO invite for Okta, IP CIDR allowlist whitelist — owner: Dev Patel (cc'd)
- Zenith: Confirm list of test IPs and Okta group mapping; upload sample dataset to Drive link (Zara)

Attachments: POC success criteria worksheet + network ranges template attached.

Next steps:
1) Liam — can you confirm the primary technical contact and the Okta admin email for invites? Also confirm any fixed IPs to allow (or confirm you'll use the CIDR list attached).
2) Dev & Ethan — if you can provision a scoped API key and send the SSO invite once Liam confirms, we can start ingestion tomorrow.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.
